phrases.latin: Hanc sēmitam sequāmur; ad rīvum dūcit.
phrases.english: Let’s follow this path; it leads to the stream.

phrases.latin: Iter est, quācumque dat prior vestīgium.
phrases.english: The path is wherever the one in front leaves a footprint.

phrases.latin: saltem aliquem velim quī mihi ex hīs locīs aut viam aut sēmitam mōnstret
phrases.english: I wish at least there were someone to show me a road or a path out of this place

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 397.
